description:
Implement only the predeclared private unroll variants and compare them with the established scalar and selected SIMD XOR kernels.

## Background

Unroll factors are experimental arms, not production routes. The study uses the frozen cell family and complexity budget, compiles intrinsic-bearing variants with Rust 1.95, retains runtime feature gating plus the tested scalar fallback, and keeps unsafe code inside `gf2-kernels-simd`. Every new unsafe boundary requires an explicit safety contract.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each predeclared unroll arm has shared equivalence coverage for aligned, offset, empty, and 0/1/63/64/65 boundary cases before timed measurement.
- [hard] REQ-02: The receipt reports raw samples, adjusted confidence bounds, equivalence results, complexity accounting, annotated release assembly, and profile explanations for each arm.
- [hard] REQ-03: No candidate enters production in this issue, and negative or inconclusive arms remain preserved.
- [hard] REQ-04: Every new unsafe boundary is isolated to `gf2-kernels-simd` and carries an explicit safety contract covering pointer validity, slice lengths, aliasing, required target features, runtime gating, and scalar fallback reachability.

## Notes

Private experimental symbols must not create a second public dispatch abstraction.
title: Measure the XOR unroll portfolio
